GENERATE BURST K3p-gen-idle-x2-02 — Keeper RELAXED idle-S loop, frames 4–6 of 16, via EDIT-CANVAS on the locked rest frame — ATTEMPT 2, method change within the hypothesis (attempt 1 measured breath 0.68 %H against a 1.96 %H floor: numbers alone did not move the amplitude; exaggeration language does — Q76). task_id "K3p-gen-idle-x2-02". (HITL Run C-2 step 6; committed relaxed band R-29/R-c; T0-e composite mechanism.) task_id "K3p-gen-idle-x2-02".

Image 1 is a 1254×1254 2×2 canvas on a pure #00ff00 plate: SLOT 0 (top-left) already holds the APPROVED REST FRAME (frame 0) of the Keeper — this exact character (a young woman; dark curly hair tied back; ivory shirt with rolled sleeves; navy sleeveless tabard, plain chest; one diagonal chestnut harness to an olive canvas satchel on her LEFT hip; one belt; laced bracers; navy trousers; chestnut boots; a plain walnut staff with brass ferrules held upright in her RIGHT hand; no insignia anywhere) — standing 470 px tall in the cell, facing the camera (direction S); slots 1 (top-right), 2 (bottom-left), 3 (bottom-right) are empty green. Deliver EXACTLY ONE image: the SAME canvas with slots 1, 2, 3 filled by idle frames 4, 5, 6 (row-major) of a 16-frame RELAXED BREATHING idle — 2.0 s at 8 fps, ONE full breath per loop: frame 4 is the peak of the inhale, frame 8 is back at rest, frame 12 is the bottom of the exhale, frame 16 returns to rest — and SLOT 0 LEFT PIXEL-IDENTICAL.
POSE SPEC per frame, relative to the rest frame (H = 470 px):
  frame 4 — chest/shoulders Δwidth +7.7 px (wider — inhaling), head Δy +1.4 px (image-down positive; never more than 2 px)
  frame 5 — chest/shoulders Δwidth +7.1 px (wider — inhaling), head Δy +1.3 px (image-down positive; never more than 2 px)
  frame 6 — chest/shoulders Δwidth +5.4 px (wider — inhaling), head Δy +1.0 px (image-down positive; never more than 2 px)
EXAGGERATE THE BREATH — this is hand-drawn game animation and the breath must READ at game scale, so draw it at CARTOON scale, about a third bigger than life: at the peak of the inhale (frame 4) the shoulders RISE and the whole chest and collar SWELL WIDER by about 25 px on this 470-px figure — the tabard's chest plane and the shirt collar visibly broaden, the harness strap bows outward, the hair mass lifts a few px; at the bottom of the exhale (frame 12) the shoulders DROP and the chest narrows by about 25 px below rest, the tabard slackening. The stated per-frame pixel deltas above are the MINIMUM — if in doubt, draw the breath BIGGER, never smaller. ONLY the shoulders, the chest/collar and the hair move; the head is CARRIED by the breath (it rises with the inhale by 1–3 px) and is otherwise a COPY of the rest frame — do NOT redraw the face or the eyes. COPIED PIXEL-FOR-PIXEL from the rest frame — trace them, do not redraw them: hips, legs, both feet (both soles on the same line), both arms and hands (the sleeves may widen with the chest but the arms do not move), the staff (grip and tip), the satchel, the belt, the face and the eyes (gaze fixed). This is hand-drawn intent: each frame is obviously moving from the previous pose toward the next; slight drawing variation inside that arc is fine, identity is not.
Every cell: IDENTICAL character size, head size, position on the cell's baseline, camera (elevated three-quarter, projection C), facing (S) and light (single key from SCREEN UPPER-LEFT, fixed for every frame; deep cool ambient; no floor shadow). Register: HAND-DRAWN painted 2D in the manner of a modern hand-animated action game — a confident dark contour line drawn by hand with visible taper and varying weight, painted fills in clean planes inside the line, restrained texture; the line carries the pose. It should look like one frame of hand-drawn animation, not a rendered illustration. Exactly four square cells, row-major, no borders, labels or gutters; flat pure #00ff00 plate; do not mirror; do not zoom; do not matte. No insignia anywhere.

One image_gen call (edit/reference mode on Image 1); ONE retry only if a cell is off-plate, mirrored, or slot 0 was altered — name the retry reason. Copy the final output to out/k3p_idle_x2_S_04_06.png and compute its sha256. No code. No other files. No web. No agents.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "K3p-gen-idle-x2-02"): images = the one file with prompt, references, elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: the 2×2 edit canvas: slot 0 = the approved rest frame (keep pixel-identical); fill slots 1–3
